linear_forest.note: linear_forest G: the whole graph G is a forest in coq-graph-theory's sense (is_forest [set: G]: unique irredundant paths) and every vertex has at most two neighbours (Delta G <= 2), i.e. a disjoint union of paths; no connectedness, nonemptiness or size guard: the empty graph, edgeless graphs, K1 and K2 qualify, the triangle (not a forest) and the claw (degree 3) do not; a path tree is exactly a connected linear forest.
